Name: Husky's Big Farmhouse
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Do you love to decorate but find that the default farmhouse is too small? This is the farmhouse for you. Large but not overwhelmingly so. With a decent flow to make it fun to live in

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Large rooms with a natural flow[/*]
[*]Every wall and trim can have things hung on it. No empty space[/*]
[*]Now Poly Sweet and Free Love compatible[/*]
[*]Custom House Upgrades from Robin[/*]
[*]A bathtub you can soak in to gain back lost energy

**new** as of version 4.1.0 you can choose to remove all but the tub from the bathroom and the window in the kitchen to give you more control ofer your decorating.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.[/*]
[*]Compatible with most recolor mods[/*]
[*][i]*NEW* [/i]Now compatible with Free Love and Polyamory Sweet[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿[/*]
[*](Optional but Recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and select your desired farm.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]

[list]
[*]You will need to use the configs via GMCM to choose your Poly Mod option or you will see layout issues in the spouse room area[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Description separators made via https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/[/*]
[/list]
